description: Reviewed contract size, gas and calldata budgets for the canonical V2 operations. Gas ceilings must stay at or below config/gas-budgets.json; deployment size limits are owned by config/deployment-size-budgets.json. Any increase over config/contract-budget-baseline.json needs a matching entry in `overrides`.

calldataModel.note: Static ABI word model: selector + fixedWords + (dynamic array offset/length) + perItemWords * bound. policyCapBytes is a repository policy limit for denial-of-service review, not a chain-enforced limit.

components: L2 execution gas x L2 gas price
L1 data fee derived from the compressed transaction bytes
feeContext.note: Calldata bytes drive the L1 data fee. No fee price or cost promise is made here; UI and API consumers must read live fee parameters and must not estimate canonical outcomes from these budgets.

claim.worstCase: Claim created with the maximum number of evidence hashes.

commit.worstCase: First commit by a verifier into a claim already holding the maximum verifier set.

reveal.worstCase: Last reveal that triggers aggregation inputs for the maximum verifier set.

dispute.worstCase: Challenge opened with the maximum number of evidence references.

appeal.worstCase: Appeal round settled over the maximum verifier set.

settlement.worstCase: Settlement batch at MAX_SETTLEMENT_BATCH_SIZE; larger batches must revert (see ScenarioGasSnapshots).

governance.worstCase: Parameter change proposal with bounded inputs.

pause.worstCase: Emergency pause across all pausable modules.
